stem:
Simran tests one food: iodine goes blue-black and the paper shows an oily patch.

What should she conclude?

options.text: A food item can contain only one nutrient.
One food item can contain more than one nutrient.
The tests cancel, so the food has nothing.

teacher.key_rationale: Two positive tests on one item mean more than one nutrient can be present. Colours do not cancel.
